scripts.validate:local: npm run test:unit && npm run idempotency-concurrency:local && npm run session-revocation:local && npm run session-rotation:local && npm run recovery:validate && npm run performance:validate && npm run performance:local
scripts.db:verify:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT 'table:' || name AS verification FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('example_resources','example_resource_changes','example_resource_scope_bindings','example_resource_decisions','users','external_identities','application_sessions','resource_scopes','scope_memberships','idempotency_records') UNION ALL SELECT 'column:example_resources:' || name AS verification FROM pragma_table_info('example_resources') WHERE name IN ('status','version') UNION ALL SELECT 'column:application_sessions:' || name AS verification FROM pragma_table_info('application_sessions') WHERE name='last_seen_at' UNION ALL SELECT 'column:users:' || name AS verification FROM pragma_table_info('users') WHERE name='status' UNION ALL SELECT 'column:idempotency_records:' || name AS verification FROM pragma_table_info('idempotency_records') WHERE name IN ('idempotency_key','fingerprint','state','expires_at','replay_status','replay_content_type','replay_body') ORDER BY verification; SELECT 'column:example_resource_decisions:' || name AS verification FROM pragma_table_info('example_resource_decisions') WHERE name IN ('source_snapshot','decision_value','rule_version','decision_version','decided_at','decided_by') ORDER BY verification; SELECT last_seen_at AS verify_last_seen_at FROM application_sessions LIMIT 1; SELECT status AS verify_user_status FROM users LIMIT 1"
